last_man_standing.title: LAST MAN STANDING
last_man_standing.draw_card_info_p1: One round protection against your selected team drawing.
last_man_standing.rules_summary_p1: Last Man Standing is a free-to-play football prediction game — where you pick one team per round to win. Win and you go through; draw or lose and you're out, unless a Draw Card protects you. Outlast everyone to win the prize.
last_man_standing.rules_summary_p2: These rules cover both the Premier League Last Man Standing (running through the EPL season) and the World Cup Last Man Standing (a one-off tournament for the 2026 FIFA World Cup). Most rules are shared; where the two differ, it's flagged under Premier League and World Cup.
last_man_standing.rules_core_p1: Each round you select one football team to win. If your team wins, you progress to the next round. If it draws or loses, you're eliminated — unless an active Draw Card protects you against a draw. The last player standing wins the prize.
last_man_standing.rules_core_intro: In full, the core rules of this elimination football game are:
last_man_standing.rules_core_b1: Select one team per round to win.
last_man_standing.rules_core_b2: If your team wins, you progress to the next round.
last_man_standing.rules_core_b3: If your team draws or loses, you're eliminated — unless an active Draw Card protects you against a draw.
last_man_standing.rules_core_b4: Make your selection before the round deadline. No valid pick by the deadline means elimination.
last_man_standing.rules_core_b5: Each tournament is separate and independent.
last_man_standing.rules_eligibility_p1: To play Last Man Standing you must be 18 or over (or the legal age for prize-based games in your jurisdiction), and only one account per person is allowed.
last_man_standing.rules_eligibility_b1: You must be 18 or over, or the legal age to take part in prize-based games in your jurisdiction.
last_man_standing.rules_eligibility_b2: One account per person. Multiple accounts are prohibited. Toshi.bet may remove any player and withhold any prize where multiple-account use is suspected.
last_man_standing.rules_entry_p1: Most Last Man Standing tournaments are free to enter, and you must join before the Round 1 deadline.
last_man_standing.rules_entry_b1: Most LMS tournaments are free to enter.
last_man_standing.rules_entry_b2: You must enter before the Round 1 deadline. Once Round 1 locks, no new players can join that tournament.
last_man_standing.rules_entry_b3: Once eliminated, you cannot re-enter the same tournament (except via a Lifeline Card in the World Cup — see below).
last_man_standing.rules_entry_p2: Premier League: new tournaments start regularly through the season, so there's always another chance to play.
last_man_standing.rules_rounds_p1: A round is a defined set of fixtures. You make one pick per round, and the deadline is when picks lock. You can change your pick any time before the deadline; once it passes, picks are locked.
last_man_standing.rules_rounds_pl_b1: Each round is one official Premier League matchweek.
last_man_standing.rules_rounds_pl_b2: The deadline is the kickoff of the first scheduled fixture in that matchweek.
last_man_standing.rules_rounds_wc_b1: The tournament runs across 16 rounds in three phases (see below).
last_man_standing.rules_rounds_wc_b2: The deadline is the kickoff of the last match in that round. World Cup rounds open and close within hours of each other, so the deadline sits at the final game of the round.
last_man_standing.rules_rounds_wc_phases_p1: The World Cup survivor game runs across 16 rounds in three phases, with different rules for the group stage and the knockouts.
last_man_standing.rules_rounds_wc_phase1: Phase 1 — Rounds 1–10 (Group Stage): pick a team to win in 90 minutes plus injury time. Each nation can be picked only once across Rounds 1–10.
last_man_standing.rules_rounds_wc_phase2: Phase 2 — Rounds 11–14 (Round of 32 & Round of 16): pick the outright winner — the result includes extra time and penalties, so there are no draws. Team-use resets at Round 11; each nation can be picked only once across Rounds 11–14.
last_man_standing.rules_rounds_wc_phase3: Phase 3 — Rounds 15–16 (Semi-finals & Final): pick the outright winner (including extra time and penalties). The same-team restriction is removed — you can pick any nation, including ones you've used before.
last_man_standing.rules_team_p1: You select one team to win each round. In the Premier League you can use each team only once per tournament; in the World Cup, team use resets between phases.
last_man_standing.rules_team_pl: Premier League: once you've used a team, you can't pick it again for the rest of that tournament.
last_man_standing.rules_team_wc: World Cup: each nation can be used once in Phase 1 (Rounds 1–10); selection resets at Round 11, with each nation usable once across Rounds 11–14; and in Rounds 15–16 there is no restriction.
last_man_standing.rules_team_p2: Used teams are clearly marked as unavailable, and your pick history stays visible.
last_man_standing.rules_results_p1: If your team wins, you progress. If it draws or loses, you're eliminated unless protected by an active Draw Card. Official results from the competition's governing body apply.
last_man_standing.rules_results_p2: The result basis depends on the round:
last_man_standing.rules_results_pl: Premier League and World Cup group stage (Rounds 1–10): 90 minutes of play plus injury time only. Extra time and penalties do not count.
last_man_standing.rules_results_wc: World Cup knockout rounds (Rounds 11–16): the outright winner, including extra time and penalties.
last_man_standing.rules_draw_p1: A Draw Card gives one round of protection against a draw. It activates automatically if your selected team draws, applies only to the round it's bought for, and does not protect against a loss.
last_man_standing.rules_draw_p2: A Draw Card must be bought before the round deadline and can't be carried forward. If you buy a Draw Card but don't submit a valid pick before the deadline, the card is forfeited and you're eliminated. The current cost is always shown at the point of purchase.
last_man_standing.rules_draw_pl_cost_intro: Maximum one Draw Card per tournament. Cost per round (LMS Points):
last_man_standing.rules_draw_wc_cost_intro: Group stage only (Rounds 1–10 — there are no draws in the knockouts). Maximum two per tournament, only one active at a time. Cost per round (World Cup Points):
last_man_standing.rules_lifeline_p1: In the World Cup only, a Lifeline Card lets you buy back into the tournament after elimination — but only in the round immediately after you went out. The Premier League LMS has no Lifeline; once you're out, you're out for that tournament.
last_man_standing.rules_lifeline_p2: If you're knocked out in Round 1, you can come back for Round 2 — you can't skip a round. There's no limit on how many times you can use a Lifeline, and it's available for re-entry up to Round 14.
last_man_standing.rules_points_p1: You earn points by wagering on Toshi.bet. Every $50 wagered earns 3 points, credited after your bets settle. Both sports betting and casino bets count — though this is a football game, so backing the football is what it's all about.
last_man_standing.rules_points_p2: Points have no cash value, can't be withdrawn or transferred, and can only be used within Last Man Standing.
last_man_standing.rules_points_pl: Premier League — LMS Points: earned across the sportsbook and casino (including Toshi's Dojo Originals).
last_man_standing.rules_points_wc: World Cup — World Cup Points: a separate currency to LMS Points. Every player starts on 0 when the tournament begins on 11 June 2026, points don't carry over from any other product, and any unused balance expires when the tournament ends on 19 July 2026.
last_man_standing.rules_postponed_p1: If your selected match is postponed after the round begins or abandoned, you progress automatically and the team still counts as used.
last_man_standing.rules_postponed_p2: A fixture postponed before the round begins won't be available to select that round.
last_man_standing.rules_postponed_p3: If a fixture is postponed after the round begins and you'd picked that team, you progress automatically. The team is still counted as used, and any Draw Card bought for that round is not consumed.
last_man_standing.rules_postponed_p4: If a selected match is abandoned, you progress automatically and the team is still counted as used.
last_man_standing.rules_visibility_p1: Once the round deadline passes, all players' selections for that round are visible to everyone, active or eliminated. After the round finishes, the table updates to show who progressed.
last_man_standing.rules_end_p1: You win by being the last player standing. Prizes are credited to the winner's Toshi.bet account within 48 hours of the tournament concluding.

last_man_standing.faq_subtitle: Quick answers to common questions about playing Last Man Standing, the free-to-play football prediction game on <toshibet>Toshi.bet</toshibet>. For the full ruleset and cost tables, see the <rules>Last Man Standing rules</rules>.
last_man_standing.faq_q1: How do I enter a tournament?
last_man_standing.faq_a1: Go to the Last Man Standing section from the <toshibet>Toshi.bet</toshibet> main menu, open any active tournament, and join before the Round 1 deadline. Once that deadline passes, no new players can join that tournament. New survivor-pool tournaments open regularly, so you're never far from another chance to play.
last_man_standing.faq_q2: Can I enter more than one tournament at once?
last_man_standing.faq_a2: Yes. Each Last Man Standing tournament is completely independent, so being knocked out of one has no effect on any other you're in. You can run several football prediction tournaments side by side.
last_man_standing.faq_q3: How do I submit my pick?
last_man_standing.faq_a3: Open your active tournament, choose one team to win, and confirm before the round deadline. You can change your pick as many times as you like right up to the deadline. Once it passes, picks are locked.
last_man_standing.faq_a4: It depends on the competition. In the Premier League survivor game, the deadline is the kickoff of the first fixture in that matchweek. In the World Cup, it's the kickoff of the last match in that round — World Cup rounds turn over quickly, so the deadline sits at the final game of the round rather than the first. The deadline countdown is always shown inside the tournament.
last_man_standing.faq_q5: Can I change my pick after submitting?
last_man_standing.faq_a5: Yes — as many times as you like, right up to the deadline, after which selections lock. It's worth checking the latest team news and odds movements before the deadline, and switching if the match-up has changed.
last_man_standing.faq_q6: What happens if I forget to submit a pick?
last_man_standing.faq_a6: No valid pick by the deadline means you're eliminated — even if you've bought a Draw Card for that round, in which case the card is forfeited. Set a reminder and submit your football prediction early to be safe.
last_man_standing.faq_q7: Can I pick the same team twice?
last_man_standing.faq_a7: In the Premier League, no — once a team is used, it's gone for the rest of that tournament. In the World Cup, each nation can be used once per phase: picks reset at Round 11, and in the semi-finals and final (Rounds 15–16) there's no restriction at all. Used nations are marked unavailable. See the <rules>team selection rules</rules> for the full breakdown.
last_man_standing.faq_a8: In the Premier League and the World Cup group stage, only 90 minutes plus injury time count — extra time and penalties don't. In the World Cup knockouts (Rounds 11–16), the outright winner counts, including extra time and penalties, so there are no draws.
last_man_standing.faq_q9: What is a Draw Card and how do I get one?
last_man_standing.faq_a9: A Draw Card gives you one round of protection against a draw — if your team draws you survive, though it doesn't protect against a loss. Buy it in your active tournament before the round deadline using points. It applies to the upcoming round only and can't be carried forward; the current cost is shown at purchase. The Premier League allows a maximum of one Draw Card per tournament; the World Cup allows up to two (group stage only, Rounds 1–10, one active at a time). Full pricing is in the <drawCardCost>Draw Card cost tables</drawCardCost>.
last_man_standing.faq_a10: The Lifeline Card is a World Cup-only feature that lets you buy back into the tournament after being knocked out — but only in the round straight after your elimination (out in Round 1, back for Round 2). You can use it as often as you can afford, up to Round 14, with the cost rising each round. The Premier League Last Man Standing has no buy-back: once you're out, you're out. See the <lifelineCost>Lifeline Card cost table</lifelineCost>.
last_man_standing.faq_q11: How do I earn World Cup points?
last_man_standing.faq_a11: Every $50 you wager on <toshibet>Toshi.bet</toshibet> earns 3 World Cup points, credited after your bets settle. Both sports betting and casino bets count. Points have no cash value and can only be used within the World Cup Last Man Standing.
last_man_standing.faq_q12: Do my points carry over between tournaments?
last_man_standing.faq_a12: Premier League LMS Points build as you play across the sportsbook and casino. World Cup Points are a separate, one-off currency: everyone starts on 0 on 11 June 2026, and any unused balance expires when the tournament ends on 19 July 2026. They don't carry over from any other product.
last_man_standing.faq_q13: What if my team's match is postponed or abandoned?
last_man_standing.faq_a13: If a fixture is postponed before the round starts, it isn't available to pick. If it's postponed after the round starts and you'd picked that team, you progress automatically, the team still counts as used, and any Draw Card isn't consumed. If a match is abandoned, you progress automatically and the team still counts as used.
last_man_standing.faq_q14: Can I re-enter after being eliminated?
last_man_standing.faq_a14: In the Premier League, no — once out, your only option is to join a new tournament, and they open regularly. In the World Cup, you can re-enter only with a Lifeline Card, and only in the round immediately after your elimination.
last_man_standing.faq_a15: Prizes are credited to your <toshibet>Toshi.bet</toshibet> account within 48 hours of the tournament concluding. If one player is left standing, they take the full prize; if more than one player is still in at the end, the prize is split equally.
last_man_standing.faq_q16: What if multiple players are still in at the end?
last_man_standing.faq_a16: If more than one player survives to the end of the competition, the prize is shared equally between all of them.
last_man_standing.faq_q17: What's the minimum age to play?
last_man_standing.faq_a17: You must be 18 or over, or the legal age for prize-based games in your jurisdiction.
last_man_standing.how_to_play_p1: Your goal is to outlast the other players and survive the longest to take home the prize.
last_man_standing.how_to_play_p3: Pick one team to win, if your chosen team wins, you progress. If your team loses or draws you are eliminated unless you have played your Draw Card. Draw Cards offer you one round of protection if your team draws. Find out more about Draw Cards from within the tournament.
last_man_standing.how_to_play_p4: You must confirm your selection before the kick off of the first fixture in that round.
last_man_standing.how_to_play_p5: You can change your pick any time until the first kick off of the first fixture in that round.
last_man_standing.how_to_play_p6: You can only select each EPL team once. Once this team has been selected they will be marked as unavailable for the remainder of the tournament.
last_man_standing.how_to_play_p7: Choose wisely as you may need your big teams at the end.
last_man_standing.how_to_play_p8: There are always new tournaments available so if you're eliminated there will always be a new one to join.

faq.a1: PREDICT6 is a free-to-play score prediction game running across the 2026 FIFA World Cup and the Premier League. Each round, <toshibet>Toshi.bet</toshibet> selects six fixtures and you predict the exact scoreline for each one. Get all six right and you win $5,000. It runs alongside <toshibet>Toshi.bet</toshibet>'s <worldCupBets>World Cup 2026 bets</worldCupBets> and Premier League betting markets, so you can play for free and wager for real in one place.
faq.a2: Yes. No deposit required, no entry fee. Just sign up and play. <toshibet>Toshi.bet</toshibet> also offers paid World Cup betting and Premier League betting offers separately for anyone who wants to wager real stakes.
faq.a3: Sign up for a <toshibet>Toshi.bet</toshibet> account, head to the World Cup Hub, and open PREDICT6. You can join at any round — you don't have to start from Round 1.
faq.q4: How do I submit my predictions?
faq.a4: Open the PREDICT6 game and predict the full time result in each fixture. Once you're happy with all six predictions, click Submit. Your picks are then locked and cannot be changed, so take your time before confirming.
faq.q5: When is the PREDICT6 round deadline?
faq.a5: The deadline is the kickoff of the first fixture in that round. The countdown is always shown inside the game.
faq.q6: Can I change my predictions after submitting?
faq.a6: No. Once you submit your predictions they are locked and cannot be changed. Make sure you're happy with all six scores before you hit submit.
faq.q7: What happens if I miss a round?
faq.a7: You score zero points for that round but you're not eliminated. You can pick up and play again the following round.
faq.a8: You earn 6 points for every correct score. Predict the exact scoreline and earn 6 points — no points are awarded for getting the result right with the wrong score.
faq.a9: If you play two or more consecutive rounds, you earn a +20% boost on all points in that round. It applies automatically — no action needed.
faq.a10: If you've wagered $1,500 or more in settled bets on <toshibet>Toshi.bet</toshibet> in the 48 hours before a round closes, you earn a +50% boost on all points in that round. It applies automatically based on your wagering activity, so placing <worldCupBets>World Cup 2026 bets</worldCupBets> or Premier League bets directly increases your PREDICT6 score.
faq.q11: Can both boosts apply at the same time?
faq.a11: Yes. If both are active they stack — you earn the benefit of both on your points for that round.
faq.q12: How does the round jackpot work?
faq.a12: Get all six predicted scores exactly right and you win $5,000. If multiple players also get all six correct, the $5,000 is split equally between them.
faq.q13: What happens if nobody gets all six correct?
faq.a13: A $1,000 consolation prize is paid instead — $600 to the top point-scorer that round, $300 to second, $100 to third.
faq.q14: What is the overall PREDICT6 prize?
faq.a14: The player with the most cumulative points across all 16 rounds wins $6,000. Second place wins $3,000, third place wins $1,000. If players are tied on points at the end of the tournament, the prize is shared equally between them.
faq.q15: How many fixtures are there per round?
faq.a15: Six in rounds 1–13. Four in the quarter-finals (Round 14), two in the semi-finals (Round 15), and one in the final (Round 16).
faq.q16: Do predictions include extra time and penalties?
faq.a16: No. All predictions are based on 90 minutes plus injury time only. Extra time and penalties never count, including in the knockout rounds.
faq.a17: Round prizes are credited to your <toshibet>Toshi.bet</toshibet> account within 48 hours of that round concluding. Overall prizes are credited within 48 hours of the Final on 19 July 2026.
faq.q18: What is the minimum age to play PREDICT6?
